design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 of rider_trip_fares_cancellations_and_refunds (category trip), revision 3. Step 0 draw (draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[5, 6]; trip_ext_upfront_guarantee_correction takes 5 factors, trip_ext_dropoff_review_request (root) takes 6.
WHY A GOOD TEST: the rider raises only a wrong drop-off. The charter sends every wrong drop-off claim to the fare review team, the rider files it herself, and the amount is figured on the fare still standing. The review rule states its own wait: 'The wrong drop-off review amount is fixed only after the trip's fare charge carries a fare adjustment entry for every part of it billed above the guaranteed fare.' The agent must read the trip's charges, see the fare charge 106.07 on an upfront basis with 0.00 recorded as member discount, work out from the correction policy that the guaranteed fare is 100.77 (the active Wayfare Pass Plus Annual plan lists Wayfare Black at 5 percent, so 5.30 should have been taken), book the correction first and only then figure the review on 97.52.
SCOPE: task 0 claims trip_ext_upfront_guarantee_correction (agent tool adjust_fare_above_guarantee_d9a21c99) and trip_ext_dropoff_review_request (user tool submit_dropoff_fare_review_f18c58a7); task 1 claims the unpaid-fare policies and their tools; the scopes are disjoint and cover all six policies.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD: root trip_ext_dropoff_review_request (owner user, on_request) <- trip_ext_upfront_guarantee_correction (owner agent, state_due); edge value_input, gate fare_still_standing, form state, sentence 'The wrong drop-off review amount is fixed only after the trip's fare charge carries a fare adjustment entry for every part of it billed above the guaranteed fare.' (connective 'only after'; record-visible state: a fare adjustment entry on the fare charge; no tool, id or code token). Only the correction writes fare adjustment entries in this difficulty. Seed falsification: trip_charges 0646bd98-117d-4fbc-8ed8-8ebfed12bb23 amount 106.07, member_discount_amount 0.0, fare_basis upfront; no trip_fare_adjustment row. Order [trip_ext_upfront_guarantee_correction, trip_ext_dropoff_review_request]; skipping the correction moves the review to 49.66.
FACTOR CARD trip_ext_upfront_guarantee_correction (baseline: correction = fare charge - fare adjustments - guaranteed fare + make-good - ride-credit deduction; guaranteed fare 100.77; make-good = guaranteed fare x 2% x 1 x 1 capped 3.00; no deduction; whole baseline 7.32). (1) makegood_rate_by_member_standing, parameter, pass, multi-source (18 months since enrollment AND 199.00 of fee charges on that membership in 12 months): 0.05 vs 0.02 -> 6.28; near-miss: the 2025-03-20 initial fee is 19 months back. (2) makegood_cap_by_fare_size, parameter: 12.00 vs 3.00 -> 7.77. (3) repeat_error_multiplier, parameter: one earlier refund -> 1.5 vs 1.0 -> 7.29. (4) makegood_timeliness, parameter: 24 days -> 0.5 vs 1.0 -> 12.86. (5) ride_credit_deduction, method (credit posted less the credit recomputed on the guaranteed fare / the whole credit posted / nothing), pass, multi-source: 0.533 vs none -> 9.08. Expected 8.55.
FACTOR CARD trip_ext_dropoff_review_request (baseline: fare still standing x 0.20 x 1 x 1, no onward reimbursement, no luggage allowance, cap 25.00; whole baseline 19.50). stranding_share 0.45 (-> 26.94); member_review_multiplier 1.15, pass (-> 41.96); review_request_cap 60.00 (-> 25.00); onward_journey_basis, method, summed charges 6.24 (-> 40.33); luggage_allowance 5.00 (-> 41.57); review_timeliness 0.7 (-> 60.00 capped). Expected 46.57. Wayfare Bikes reads are not counted as cross-difficulty; the task's cross-difficulty factors are the Pass ones.
CROSS-DIFFICULTY CREDIT CHECK (published Pass corpus): the Pass clawback on adjusted fares ('Wayfare Pass Ride Credit — Clawback on Adjusted Fares Calculation Sheet') claws back nothing when the fare adjustments take back less than a tenth of the eligible fare and leave at least 5.00; here 8.55 < 10.607 and 97.52 is left, so no credit forfeiture is owed and forfeit_pass_ride_credit_4b5902d4 has nothing to book (it takes a positive amount). The trip correction's own rule makes the split explicit: the ride-credit deduction applies only when the correction before the deduction is under the ledger-correction share (a tenth) of the eligible fare; at a tenth or more the deduction is nil and the credit is left to the Pass ledger, so the credit is never recovered twice. Credit postings are seeded 48 hours after each drop-off (2026-08-16, 2026-09-28) as the Pass posting delay provides, so no late-posting goodwill or posting write is owed either.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: both writes have subject trip_fare_adjustment, governed by trip_evt_adjustments_and_refunds: within_review_window (anchor the fare charge date 2026-09-26; 30 calendar days; day 1 2026-09-27, inclusive last day 2026-10-26; 2026-10-20 is day 24) and within_support_limit (Black limit 40.00; earlier refund 4.66 + correction 8.55 = 13.21 <= 40.00; the wrong drop-off claim goes to the review team by the same sentence). Overwrite on trip_ext_upfront_guarantee_correction: the base fare_above_upfront clause is replaced by the correction sentence.
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: target fare charge 0646bd98-117d-4fbc-8ed8-8ebfed12bb23 of trip ea18ca0c-06d3-4e74-88f2-09771db4fab3; included: the fare charge, fare adjustments on the trip (none before step 9, 8.55 after), refund 4d95e476-9b94-44fd-8e9e-b888c48b884b (repeat-error count, support total), the airport fee entries (luggage), the Pass credit posted for the trip 31546556-7424-4611-8ddc-b13ecbf8514a (deduction), fee charges on membership 699ae6e0-04fe-4fe1-8d90-eaf1c3178227 (rate tier); excluded: the Comfort trip 6797bd20-1080-4825-8634-e24d92d8a166 and its charge, bike ride d7af9c69-1d39-4d91-9ef7-cac0896f9422 (other date), the fee charge older than 12 months 9bba0f80-21fd-4842-b851-1129f84454d1.
WORLD AND PERSONA: rider profile; Pass Plus Annual enrolled 2025-03-20 with two fee charges and two credit earns (each 10 percent of an eligible fare, posted 48 hours after drop-off); Wayfare Bikes Annual plan with plan fee and three e-bike ride charges; trips T0 (target) and T0B. Celeste calls 24 days after the ride, volunteers only the wrong drop-off and the e-bike, verifies with phone and date of birth, agrees to a correction only after the agent raises it, files the review when handed the amount, and closes. She states no figures.
STANDARD SOLUTION AND CHECKS: find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, DOB) -> find_trips -> find_trip_charges(customer) -> find_pass_memberships -> find_pass_events -> find_bike_plans -> find_bike_rides -> unlock/call adjust_fare_above_guarantee_d9a21c99(T0, F1, 8.55) -> unlock_user/call_user submit_dropoff_fare_review_f18c58a7(T0, F1, 46.57). check_compute recomputes 8.55 / 46.57, every factor's baseline figure and the whole baselines 7.32 / 19.50.
REVISION 2 (policy-task audit round 2): G-1a/G-1b/G-O1/G-O6/T0-O1 closed (discount moved into the standard computation; ride-credit deduction as the correction's method factor; onward-journey basis as the review's method factor; multiplier factors relabelled parameter; zero floor stated; fees summed on the tested membership; luggage trace corrected).
REVISION 3 (KB-runtime audit revision_2, task 0 RED: the published Pass clawback made a credit forfeiture owed after the scored fare adjustment and double-recovered the credit the correction already deducts). Route-around within the trip domain: (a) the ride-credit deduction now applies only while the correction before the deduction is under a tenth of the eligible fare, the Pass clawback's own threshold, and is nil otherwise, so trip and Pass never both recover the same credit; (b) the world was re-cut so the billing error is the missed member discount (fare charged at the full upfront fare 106.07), the rider an established member (enrolled 2025-03-20) and the call 24 days after the ride (frozen 2026-10-20), giving a correction of 8.55, under a tenth of 106.07, so the Pass clawback is nothing and no Pass write is owed; (c) credit postings moved to 48 hours after drop-off; (d) the standard make-good cap is 3.00 so the cap still bears weight. Scored values moved: adjustment_amount 27.52 -> 8.55, requested_amount 51.37 -> 46.57; all traces, closure, contract and rationale texts were rewritten to the new values.
user_scenario: You are Celeste Bramwell, an event planner in Phoenix who is polite, brisk and a little tired of being on hold; you speak in short, practical sentences and you do not like repeating yourself. You open the call by saying: "Hi, this is Celeste Bramwell. I'm calling about a Wayfare Black ride I took from Sky Harbor on the evening of September 26th — the driver dropped me off in the wrong place, almost two and a half miles short of the resort I'd asked for, and I had to finish the trip on one of your e-bikes in heels. I'd like that put right." That is all you volunteer at first. You do not know Wayfare's rules, fees or how they work out a refund, and you never suggest a figure yourself. If the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give your mobile number first ("my number is 6025550112") and, if a second detail is wanted, my date of birth is 1988-06-14; only if both of those somehow fail do you add that the card on my profile ends in 1847. If the agent asks which trip, you describe it as the Black ride you took from the airport, Terminal 4, on Saturday September 26th, around seven in the evening, heading to the Camelback resort. If asked whether you changed the destination or added a stop during the ride, you say no, you never touched the route; the driver simply pulled over on a frontage road, said that was it, and ended the trip. If asked how you got the rest of the way, you say you unlocked a Wayfare e-bike right there and rode it to the resort, because nothing else was around. You never bring up the fare amount, the airport fee or anything else on your receipt; you admit you did not look closely at the receipt. If the agent explains that something on the trip's charges needs to be corrected before your wrong drop-off request can be worked out, and asks whether that is all right, you say yes, go ahead and fix whatever needs fixing. When the agent tells you that a wrong drop-off claim has to go to the fare review team and hands you the request to file in your app with an amount, you file it exactly as the agent describes, using the amount the agent gives you, and you read back the reference number the app shows you if the agent asks for it. If the agent instead offers to simply refund the fare or the whole ride on the spot, you say you just want whatever the proper process is. Once the review request is filed and the agent has confirmed it is with the review team, you thank them and say that is everything you needed today, and you end the call.

Wayfare Comfort, on demand, PHX, completed 2026-08-14; upfront 25.83 = max(10.50, 2.10 + 1.38 x 9.80 + 0.33 x 22) + 2.95; net_charged 24.69 equals its single fare charge.

Upfront basis fare of the Comfort trip: the Plus Annual member discount 5 percent of (25.83 - 2.95) = 1.14 was taken and recorded; amount 25.83 - 1.14 = 24.69; Pass ride credit 2.17 posted for it on 2026-08-16, 48 hours after drop-off — the normal treatment, showing how the discount is recorded when it is applied.

Fare charge of the Black trip on an upfront basis at the full upfront fare 106.07: the active Plus Annual plan lists Wayfare Black for its 5 percent member discount, so 100.77 should have been charged; 0.00 was recorded as discount — the billing error the correction addresses. Ride credit of 10.61 (10 percent of 106.07, under the 15.00 per-trip cap) was posted for it on 2026-09-28, 48 hours after drop-off as the Pass posting delay provides.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Book the upfront guarantee correction of 8.55 against the trip's fare charge, so the fare charge no longer stands above the guaranteed fare and the fare still standing becomes 97.52.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.adjustment_amount: 8.55. Fare charge 106.07 (trip_charges 0646bd98-117d-4fbc-8ed8-8ebfed12bb23), no fare adjustment booked before. Guarantee discount: the membership in force at the request is Wayfare Pass Plus Annual, active, and lists Wayfare Black, so the fare should have carried 5 percent of (upfront 106.07 - Black booking fee 0.00) = 5.3035, rounded half up to 5.30; the fare was charged at the full upfront fare with 0.00 recorded. Guaranteed fare 106.07 - 5.30 = 100.77; billed above it 106.07 - 0 - 100.77 = 5.30. Make-good rate: enrolled 2025-03-20, 18 whole months before 2026-10-20 (>= 12, < 24), and 199.00 of fee charges booked on that membership in the last 12 months (>= 90.00) -> established member rate 0.05. Repeat-error multiplier: exactly one earlier support entry on the trip (the 2026-09-28 duplicate-charge refund 4d95e476-9b94-44fd-8e9e-b888c48b884b) -> 1.5. Timeliness: 24 days from the 2026-09-26 charge date (>= 21) -> 0.5. Make-good 100.77 x 0.05 x 1.5 x 0.5 = 3.778875, under the large-fare cap 12.00 (fare >= 75.00). Correction before the deduction 5.30 + 3.778875 = 9.078875, under the ledger-correction share 0.10 of the eligible fare 106.07 (10.607), so the deduction applies: 10.61 of credit was posted for the trip (31546556-7424-4611-8ddc-b13ecbf8514a) while the membership was active, and the guaranteed fare earns 10 percent of 100.77 = 10.077 (under the 15.00 per-trip cap), so the deduction is 10.61 - 10.077 = 0.533. Correction 9.078875 - 0.533 = 8.545875, not below zero and within 106.07, rounded half up once -> 8.55.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.trip_id: Id of the trip whose fare charge is corrected: ea18ca0c-06d3-4e74-88f2-09771db4fab3, the Wayfare Black trip of 2026-09-26 from PHX returned by find_trips; the tool docstring asks for 'the trip reference number of the completed trip whose fare is being corrected'. It is the only trip of the rider on that date and the one the caller described, so no other trip qualifies.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.original_charge_id: Id of the fare charge reduced: 0646bd98-117d-4fbc-8ed8-8ebfed12bb23, the only trip_fare_charge entry on the trip (find_trip_charges). The rule books the correction 'against that fare charge'; the airport fee entries and the refund are not fare charges, so no other id qualifies.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock the wrong drop-off fare review filing and hand it to the rider.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the hand-over: the wrong drop-off review is filed by the rider herself; no DB effect; unlocked once.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The rider files the wrong drop-off review for the trip's fare charge at 46.57.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.requested_amount: 46.57. Fare still standing: fare charge 106.07 less the fare adjustment just booked 8.55 = 97.52. Stranding share: actual 19.10 miles fall 2.30 short of the estimated 21.40 (>= 1.5) and a Wayfare Bikes ride (29e8a9bb-14ce-4ca0-8d11-2987b31e999d, 6.24, e-bike) is charged on 2026-09-26, the fare charge date -> 0.45 (the 2026-09-25 ride d7af9c69-1d39-4d91-9ef7-cac0896f9422 is another date). Member review multiplier: Wayfare Pass Plus Annual, active -> 1.15. Review timeliness: 24 days (>= 21) -> 0.7. 97.52 x 0.45 x 1.15 x 0.7 = 35.326620. Onward-journey reimbursement: the bike ride charges on that date come to 6.24 >= 5.00, so the reimbursement is the sum of those charges, 6.24. Luggage allowance: the trip carries airport fee entries and its airport end was the pickup -> 5.00. Total 46.566620, under the premium review request cap 60.00 (fare 106.07 >= 100.00), rounded half up once -> 46.57.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.trip_id: Id of the trip under review: ea18ca0c-06d3-4e74-88f2-09771db4fab3, the same trip the caller described and the agent corrected; the docstring asks for 'the trip reference number of the trip under review, as read out by the agent from the trip lookup'. No other trip of the rider ended away from its destination.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.original_charge_id: Id of the disputed fare charge: 0646bd98-117d-4fbc-8ed8-8ebfed12bb23; the rule files the review 'for the trip's fare charge', and the trip carries only one fare charge (the airport fees and the refund are other kinds of entries).

factor_trace: makegood_rate_by_member_standing (parameter, cross-difficulty pass, multi-source): enrolled 2025-03-20 -> 18 months to 2026-10-20; fee charges booked on membership 699ae6e0-04fe-4fe1-8d90-eaf1c3178227 in the last 12 months = 199.00 (fa2e2d7a-3271-4a0a-b044-9b711f2e145b; the 2025-03-20 initial fee 9bba0f80-21fd-4842-b851-1129f84454d1 falls outside) -> established rate 0.05; the standard rate 0.02 gives 6.28.
makegood_cap_by_fare_size (parameter): fare charge 106.07 >= 75.00 -> large-fare cap 12.00 (make-good 3.778875 stays under it); the standard cap 3.00 would bind and give 7.77.
repeat_error_multiplier (parameter): one earlier support entry on the trip (refund 4d95e476-9b94-44fd-8e9e-b888c48b884b of a duplicated airport fee) -> 1.5; the standard 1.0 gives 7.29.

edges.condition: The trip's fare charge carries a fare adjustment entry of the fare-above-upfront kind taking back the part of the fare charge billed above the guaranteed fare, so that the fare adjustments booked on the trip are reflected in the fare still standing.
edges.policy_source: The wrong drop-off review amount is fixed only after the trip's fare charge carries a fare adjustment entry for every part of it billed above the guaranteed fare.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The fare charge stands at 106.07 on an upfront basis while the guaranteed fare is 100.77 (upfront 106.07 less the Plus discount 5.30 that was never taken), and no fare adjustment entry exists on the trip, so the part billed above the guaranteed fare carries no fare adjustment.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: The correction at step 9 books a fare adjustment of -8.55 against the fare charge; the fare still standing drops from 106.07 to 97.52 and the wrong drop-off review amount is figured on 97.52.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Single edge: the correction must precede the review because the review amount is figured on the fare still standing, which only the correction changes; filing the review first would give 49.66 instead of 46.57. No further write is owed after the correction: the Wayfare Pass clawback on adjusted fares takes back nothing when the adjustments take back less than a tenth of the eligible fare (8.55 against 10.607 here), so the published Pass rules leave the credit earn entry as it is.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the correction leaves the fare still standing at 106.07; the review amount becomes 106.07 x 0.45 x 1.15 x 0.7 + 6.24 + 5.00 = 49.66 (instead of 46.57), and no fare adjustment row of -8.55 exists, so both the review row and the trip charges differ from gold.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona only describes the wrong drop-off and the e-bike; it never mentions the fare amount, the upfront price, the Pass discount, an overcharge or any correction, and states she did not look at the receipt; she agrees to a correction only after the agent raises it.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: submit_dropoff_fare_review_f18c58a7 writes the review row with whatever amount it is given and never reads the fare adjustments; adjust_fare_above_guarantee_d9a21c99 writes the adjustment without checking amounts or windows.
